title: SC: 'Bloated' unprogrammed funds in nat'l budget 'unconstitutional'

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court has declared “unconstitutional” certain provisions of the 2024 and 2025 national budgets, as well as key unprogrammed appropriations in the 2026 budget, after finding that Congress increased funding beyond the amount recommended by the president. In a 121-page decision penned by Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen, the SC said Congress committed grave abuse of discretion by “bloating” the Executive Branch’s recommended budget for unprogrammed funds from P281.9 billion in the National Expenditure Program (NEP) to P731.4 billion in the enacted 2024 budget.
